svg.text: Semantic network: Rubi, the rebana ubi expert system
Dry hide → turn body on lathe →
cut wedges → fit, tie and tune
Sources: Siti Hajar Abdul Halim (2024); PUSAKA (n.d.); Kraftangan Malaysia (n.d.-a, n.d.-b, n.d.-c); Akhi Sahrul (n.d.); Dewan Bahasa dan Pustaka (n.d.); JKKN (2024). Full references in knowledge.js.
